name: Write deploy facts recalled from memory
description: Two facts live only in memory. The agent must recall both and write them into a file. Memory-discriminating; checks the file content, so the recall must have happened
prompt: Create deploy.json as a JSON object with two keys: region holds the deploy region and owner holds the deploy owner. Both values are stored in memory. Look them up, then write deploy.json with the write_file tool. Then reply with the word done.
